description: The limit minus the headroom minus the process baseline: what the batches alive at once may use.
The largest batch is the memory for batches divided by bytes per row and batches alive, capped by the sink limit; the smallest is set by the per-call overhead and the time window.
One full read of a one-shot source such as a cursor or a generator; a second read is a second scan.
Build a list or dict only of the small final result that must be read more than once, never of the rows between stages.
The position of the last acknowledged batch; a failed run resumes there instead of at row 0.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
